Problem Statement:
In a Test cricket match the runs scored by batsmen are given to you. Your task is to print partnership formed by batsmen.if it is assumed that if there are ‘n’ batsmen then n-1 wicket will fall and each batsmen will divide his individual runs equally in all partnerships he is involved in. Note :batsmen will fall serial wise and last batsmen will remain not out 
Input Description:
You are given a number ‘n’,representing the number of batsmen.Next line contains n space separated integers representing score of each batsman 
Output Description:
Print the score in n-1 partnership 
Sample Input:
5 
10 36 64 98 100 
Sample Output:
28 50 96 81 149 
Explanation:
first batsmen will not be involved in two partnerships, hence first partnership total is 10+18=28 second partnership involves 18+32 =50 runs, …. In last partnership the runs of last batsmen will be directly added to total of partnership.
